notes: Data + literature converge: full fibroblast-program co-expression (incl. non-secreted SOX5/CALD1, which ambient RNA does not transfer) = doublets; Scrublet confirms 34.6-47% in those clusters vs ~0% in real macrophage states. Genuine pro-fibrotic macrophages (TREM2+/SPP1+/CD9+ scar-associated, Ramachandran 2019) act via PDGFB, not collagen transcription, and in this dataset are the separate lipid/foamy TAM cluster. Macrophage collagen *protein* endocytosis (uPARAP/MRC1) and partial/selective expression (type VI; isolated COL1A1 in ILD) are real but do not explain a full structural-collagen mRNA program.
